expected_headings.text: County Employment and Wages - Fourth Quarter 2025

expected_tables.location: spans nearly the entire document, from page ~2 through page ~14/15 (page numbers approximate, not individually re-counted per page in this pass)
expected_tables.notes: Table 1: 'Covered establishments, employment, and wages in the 373 largest counties, fourth quarter 2025'. Verified directly via pdftotext -layout: the 'Table 1.' caption appears 8 times total -- once as the original heading (no 'Continued' suffix) plus 7 more times with '- Continued' appended -- each time followed by a FULL re-statement of the two-level column header (top level: 'Employment' / 'Average weekly wage ²' spanning grouped sub-columns; second level: 'Establishments, fourth quarter 2025', 'December 2025', 'Percent change, December 2024-25³', 'Ranking by percent change', 'Fourth quarter 2025', 'Percent change...', 'Ranking by percent change' again). Body rows use dot-leader fill characters between the county name and its first numeric column (e.g. 'Baldwin, AL..................................    9.7    87.8 ...'), a legitimate visual-alignment device WITHIN a real table, distinct from fixture 16's dot-leaders in a Table of Contents (which is NOT a table).

math_notes: No mathematical notation; footnote markers (superscript numbers 1-5) appear throughout the table header and body referencing endnote explanations, which could be mistaken for exponents/math notation by an overeager math-detector -- worth a light sanity check that these aren't flagged as 'math present'.
expected_noise_elements: The exact same 'Table 1' caption + full two-level column header repeats verbatim at the top of 8 separate pages (1 original + 7 '- Continued' instances, precisely verified via grep -- an earlier draft of this rubric overstated this as '11+', which actually conflated Table 1's own repeats with separate '- Continued' occurrences belonging to Table 2 and Table 3 captions later in the document; corrected after independent re-verification) -- Pith must recognize these 8 as CONTINUATIONS of the same single logical table, not as 8 separate small tables
Footnote markers (superscript 1-5) scattered through headers and body cells, resolved in a footnotes/endnotes section elsewhere in the release
'For release 10:00 a.m. (ET)' and technical/media contact info block repeated as a running header on page 1 only
notes_for_implementer: PRIMARY test target: this is the canonical 'table split across pages' fixture. The 373-county table's caption and full column header repeat at the top of 8 pages it spans (1 original + 7 explicitly marked '- Continued', directly re-verified via pdftotext -layout). Pith must merge these into ONE logical table of 373 data rows, not 8 separate small tables each starting fresh -- the repeated caption/header on each page is the exact signal that should trigger continuation-merging rather than being treated as independent table headers. Note the document also contains at least two OTHER tables (Table 2, Table 3) later on, each with their own '- Continued' repeats -- do not conflate their counts with Table 1's when verifying this fixture. Secondary point: the dot-leader characters used to visually connect each county name to its first data column ARE part of a genuine table's body formatting here (unlike fixture 16, where dot-leaders appear in a Table of Contents that is NOT a table) -- useful contrast case for whether Pith's table detector distinguishes 'dot leaders inside a real tabular structure' from 'dot leaders inside a ToC'.
